event_description: User lands on the Join Us page — top of the sign-up conversion funnel.
User clicks the Join Us submit button on the sign-up form.
User clicks one of the three content panels on the homepage (The Idea, In Practice, or Join Us).
User scrolls to the bottom of The Idea article, indicating they read it in full.
User scrolls to the bottom of the In Practice article, indicating they read it in full.
